import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Map 'is_fraud' to descriptive labels for better readability in plots
df['is_fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Not Fraud', 1: 'Fraud'})

# Set up the matplotlib figure and axes for a 2x2 grid
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Analysis: Key Features by Fraud Status', fontsize=18, weight='bold', y=0.98)

# Define a consistent color palette for 'is_fraud_label'
fraud_palette = {
    'Not Fraud': '#4CAF50',  # Green for not fraud
    'Fraud': '#FF5733'       # Red/Orange for fraud
}

# Plot 1: Distribution of Transaction Amount by Fraud Status (KDE Plot)
sns.kdeplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='is_fraud_label', fill=True, common_norm=False, ax=axes[0, 0], palette=fraud_palette, linewidth=2)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amount', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Fraud Status', loc='upper right')
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)


# Plot 2: Distribution of Hour of Day by Fraud Status (Histogram)
# Using 'dodge' to show counts side-by-side for each hour
sns.histplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud_label', multiple='dodge', bins=24, shrink=0.8, ax=axes[0, 1], palette=fraud_palette)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Count by Hour of Day', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day (0-23)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2)) # Set ticks for every 2 hours for clarity
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Fraud Status', loc='upper right')
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)


# Plot 3: Transaction Type Counts by Fraud Status (Count Plot)
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud_label', ax=axes[1, 0], palette=fraud_palette)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Transaction Type Counts', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Fraud Status', loc='upper right')
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)


# Plot 4: Transaction Amount Distribution by Type and Fraud Status (Box Plot)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud_label', ax=axes[1, 1], palette=fraud_palette, linewidth=1.5)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15) # Rotate x-axis labels if they overlap for better readability
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Fraud Status', loc='upper right')
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)


# Adjust layout to prevent overlapping titles and labels
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95]) # Adjust rect to make space for the main suptitle

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
